scope: End-to-end software and regression verification; not regulatory certification

English browser signup, Saudi phone normalization, account draft migration and duplicate phone
Private PDF storage, owner checks, malformed PDF rejection and duplicate submission protection
Signature and both subscription UI submissions, server totals and optional email capture
Account/admin previews, manual PDF upload, dashboard counts and ZIP exact-byte contents
Individual Arabic and company English subscription edits, recalculated amounts and prior-PDF preservation

Client edit/resubmit and reload, separate working draft, signature recovery, immutable originals, archive dates, stale-edit rejection, owner restore, restore retry/CSRF, replacement upload and audience/account version isolation
Owner reset, strong one-time displayed password, old password/session revocation and mandatory change
Original side-by-side logos, My applications page in English/Arabic, compatible account links, mobile layouts, existing catalogue navigation and persistent login throttling

Private storage and credentials remain inaccessible
